## Job Description

Summary: Trusaic is a regulatory compliance software company focused on creating better work environments for everyone. The Sales Development Representative will support the sales function by identifying new business opportunities and acting as a liaison between the Marketing and Sales teams.

Responsibilities:

\- Generate qualified prospects through daily outbound cold calls, emails, and messages

\- Schedule appointments for the Business Development team

\- Maintain active communication and follow-up with leads using a strategic sales cadence

\- Keep the sales pipeline full to consistently move potential clients through the sales process

\- Identify and research target companies to understand target organizations’ products and/or services

\- Ad-hoc projects as necessary with Trusaic’s sales team

\- Contact and call inbound leads from Marketing (50% inbound, 50% outbound)

\- Prospect potential clients through phone, email, and social media outreach campaigns

\- Identify new company and individual opportunities using sales intelligence tools

\- Design and execute territory-specific plans in partnership with Account Executive sales colleagues

\- Develop your skills by participating in weekly team meetings and ongoing training

\- Track progress and update activities in the CRM

Required Qualifications:

\- Bachelor's Degree

\- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

\- Strong interpersonal skills to engage effectively with potential clients

\- Outbound SDR experience is required

\- Familiarity with CRM tools like HubSpot or Salesforce

\- Familiarity with Navigator, Orum, or similar dialing software

\- Experience with ZoomInfo data and websites

\- Knowledge of intent data and its application in sales prospecting

\- Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail

\- Self-starter with the ability to work independently

Preferred Qualifications:

\- Experience prospecting into HR roles for SaaS tech is a plus

Required Skills: Outbound sales development representative experience, CRM tools - HubSpot, CRM tools - Salesforce, Dialing software - Navigator, Dialing software - Orum, ZoomInfo data, Intent data application in sales prospecting, Sales prospecting into HR roles for SaaS technology

Benefits: Opportunity to own shares in Trusaic and participate in the company’s growth, Medical, Dental and vision insurance, 401K plan (eligibility after 60 days), 3 weeks PTO + 8 paid holidays (including 1 flexible holiday), Career development opportunities
